name: melee_swing
about: Melee: a hostile bat-armed Troika human starts 120 cm (47 units) in front of the player, facing it. After SCHED_TROIKA_START_COMBAT 0xea the weapon split takes slot 604 0x10385e40; slot 599 admits melee; with the player inside melee range and in the cone and no SHOULD_DODGE / SHOULD_BLOCK / SHOULD_KICK / SHOULD_STEPBACK, the tail answers the in-reach attack. The NPC is bat-only, so slot 308 HasUsableRangedWeapon 0x10336d70 is false and the selector answers the _NR forms (CNPC_VHumanCombatant::SelectSchedule 0x103872d0 -> slot 604 CNPC_VHuman::SelectScheduleMeleeCombat 0x10385e40; stories/v4/packets-S3.md item 8): in reach (CAN_MELEE_ATTACK1 0x51) 0xdd SCHED_TROIKA_MELEE_ATTACK1_NR (line 0x65d) -> MELEE_ATTACK1_SWING 0xde -> TASK_MELEE_ATTACK1; out of reach (0x09 / 0x60) 0xcb SCHED_TROIKA_MELEE_ADVANCE_NR (line 0x6b0), 0xd2 the approach inside 100 units without 0x51 (line 0x6bb), 0xe1 the circle. 0xdc / 0xca / 0xe0 are the forms of an NPC that also carries a usable ranged weapon. One SCHED_TROIKA_MELEE_IDLE (0xc7) first is retail: the selection that admits the NPC to melee has gathered no band word yet, so no `never` here forbids a single MELEE_IDLE after START_COMBAT. The melee band is the weapon's slot 367 (0x103eac30 -> 0x103ea7e0, walked in stories/v4/packets-S2.md item 4), not the NPC's slot 555. sched_troika_melee_attack1(_nr).sch: SET_FAIL_SCHEDULE MELEE_IDLE, FACE_ENEMY, STOP_MOVING, SET_SCHEDULE SCHED_TROIKA_MELEE_ATTACK1_SWING; _swing: ANNOUNCE_ATTACK 1, TASK_MELEE_ATTACK1, no interrupts. TASK_MELEE_ATTACK1's start arm 0x102a45c6 (weapon +0x5a0 & 0x18000) writes m_flLastAttackTime and calls the weapon's slot 326 PrimaryAttack (CWeaponMelee 0x103eaca0 -> slot 372 RequestActivity(0x4b, 1, 1) 0x103e9e00: the swing sequence on the owner). The contact has NO animation event: no attack clip in the male `baseball` bank authors one (stories/v4/packets-R2.md item 3c); it is the NPC's own slot 312 UpdateCharacter 0x103246d0 -> MeleeSwingUpdate 0x10346cd0, reached from the Troika think's tail 0x1029365b after PostRun and PerformMovement. The sweep lands damage on the player (CBasePlayer::OnTakeDamage 0x10163020), and the task completes on IsActivityFinished.
notes: Corrected by the V4a seam (record errors, J7): `hit_event` (an animevent, match '') is replaced by `hit`, a damage on the player from the brawler after TASK_MELEE_ATTACK1 starts -- retail's contact is the sweep, not an event; the schedule matches take the _NR forms. The `never` on the brawler forbids a WEAPON-BAND animevent (3000..0xfa2) from the swing on: the schema has no window that closes at a label, so it runs from `swing` to the record's end rather than to the swing's taskdone, and it is narrowed to the weapon band so the footsteps of a later advance (2050..2053) are not counted. A bat-only NPC dispatches no weapon-band event at all in retail, so the wider window states nothing retail does not.
